source_title: Cokanasiga scores twice as Bath overcome Sale
source_excerpt:
Bath had lost their past two Prem games and another in the Champions Cup prior to facing Sale
Tries: Arundell, De Glanville, Cokanasiga 2, Hennessey Cons: Russell 4 Pens: Russell
Tries: Jibulu, O'Flaherty, Cowan-Dickie, Canakaivata Cons: Ford 4
Joe Cokanasiga scored twice as Bath ended a three-game winless run in all competitions with victory over Sale.
Henry Arundell, Tom de Glanville and Louis Hennessey also got on the scoreboard for the hosts as they took a maximum of five points to go into the international break on a high.
Nathan Jibulu and Tom O'Flaherty crossed for Sale and they were largely outclassed until the final 10 minutes when Luke Cowan-Dickie and Elia Canakaivata added late tries, to ensure the Sharks at least left the Recreation Ground with a point.
The result is the third loss of the campaign for Sale and means they go into the international break eighth, while Bath move up to fourth.

Bath have been hit by a raft of injuries to their backline in the early part of the season and while they are now without Santiago Carreras for the rest of the campaign, De Glanville and Arundell's return from injuries proved timely.
Arundell needed less than three minutes to bag a try on his first Prem game of the season when he charged through a gap on halfway and used his speed to race into the corner.
Sale then enjoyed their best spell of pressure until the end of the game although were unable to turn frequent entries into Bath's 22 into more than one try.
Prop Asher Opoku-Fordjour was turned over a few metres out and Joe Carpenter dropped a long pass when he had acres of space ahead, before Jibulu brought them level carrying over from the back of a maul.
De Glanville restored Bath's lead, as the hosts switched direction across the pitch from a line-out and the full-back dashed through a gap when Tom Roebuck slipped trying to make a tackle.
Cokanasiga added their third with a well-worked team try started when Arundell caught a high ball on halfway, and they whipped it quickly through their backs, and in a two-on-one with De Glanville, Cokanasiga had a simple finish.
The wing had his second and Bath's bonus-point fourth immediately into the second half, when he jumped to catch Russell's cross-field kick, side-stepped past Alex Lozowski and stretched over under a tackle.
O'Flaherty replied minutes later at the other end with a superb one-handed dive into the corner as Sale looked for a way back in.
A Russell penalty stretched Bath 15 points clear and Hennessey ran on to a Bernard van der Linde grubber kick a minute after coming on to all-but seal victory.
Yet Sale rallied to end the game on top, with Cowan-Dickie barging through before Canakaivata grabbed another try in the final minute to give Sale a point.
'We amalgamated all parts of our game' - reaction
Bath director of rugby Johann van Graan told BBC Radio Bristol:
"It was two teams that really wanted to win. We started the game really well - the way we defended on our goalline and worked back it was really impressive.
"Straight after half-time we came out scored our fourth try. Unfortunately we invited some pressure on us but I thought we were really positive and some lovely play both sides of the ball.
"We amalgamated all parts of our game, breakdown, set piece, the contact, attack, defence, the kicking game, so I'm really happy with the performance. Certainly not perfect but a great way to finish this block."
Sale director of rugby Alex Sanderson said:
"I'm really impressed with aspects of our game as we had physicality in spades and showed much better intention to run the ball.
"We created opportunities but left points out there as our execution wasn't good enough. We were 19-7 down at half-time, but it could have easily between 21-19.
"We fell to some sucker punches and there were big momentum swings but despite being 36-14 down, we wrestled something back from nothing to earn a bonus point.
"However we weren't good enough to win as they were more dangerous than us in the wide channels and they won the aerial battles, but I truly believe we are not far off and will get where we to be in the end."
Bath : De Glanville; Cokanasiga, Lawrence, Ojomoh, Arundell; Russell, Spencer (c); Obano, Frost, Griffin, Jeanes, Ewels, Hill, Reid, Bayliss.
Replacements : Dunn, Wheeler, Stuart, Opoku-Gyamfi, Richards, Van Der Linde, Hennessey, Coetzee.
Sale : Carpenter; Roebuck, Marchant, Lozowski, O'Flaherty; Ford, Warr; Smith, Jibulu, Opoku-Fordjour, Van Rhyn (c), Bamber, Tshiunza, B. Curry, T. Curry.
Replacements : Cowan-Dickie, McIntyre, Francis, Burrow, Dugdale, Hanson, Ma'asi-White, Canakaivata.

## बाथ की शानदार वापसी

हालिया रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, बाथ ने सेल के खिलाफ मुकाबले में जीत हासिल कर सभी प्रतियोगिताओं में अपने तीन मैचों के winless run को समाप्त कर दिया है। इस मैच में जो कोकानासिगा ने दो शानदार ट्राई किए, जिससे टीम को अंतरराष्ट्रीय ब्रेक से पहले पांच अंक प्राप्त हुए।

## मैच के मुख्य आकर्षण

* **प्रमुख खिलाड़ी:** हेनरी अरुंडेल, टॉम डी ग्लैनविले और लुई हेनेसी ने भी बाथ के लिए स्कोर किया।
* **शुरुआती बढ़त:** अरुंडेल ने मैच के शुरुआती मिनटों में ही अपनी गति का प्रदर्शन करते हुए पहला ट्राई किया।
* **स्कोरिंग:** फिन रसेल ने चार कन्वर्जन और एक पेनल्टी के साथ बाथ के स्कोर में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया।

## सेल का संघर्ष और अंत में वापसी

मैच के अधिकांश समय सेल की टीम पिछड़ती नजर आई और शुरुआती दौर में वे अपनी पकड़ मजबूत नहीं कर सके। हालांकि, खेल के अंतिम 10 मिनटों में ल्यूक कोवान-डिकी और एलिया कैनाकाइवाटा ने लेट ट्राई करके सेल को एक बहुमूल्य बोनस अंक दिलाया। इस हार के बाद सेल की टीम तालिका में आठवें स्थान पर चली गई है, जबकि बाथ चौथे स्थान पर पहुंच गई है।

## डाइनरेक्टर की प्रतिक्रियाएं

* **जोहान वान गान (बाथ):** उन्होंने टीम के प्रदर्शन पर संतोष व्यक्त करते हुए कहा कि खिलाड़ियों ने खेल के हर विभाग में अच्छा तालमेल दिखाया।
* **एलेक्स सैंडरसन (सेल):** उन्होंने माना कि टीम ने शारीरिक रूप से कड़ा मुकाबला किया और मौके बनाए, लेकिन निष्पादन की कमी के कारण वे मैच जीतने में असफल रहे।

## सत्यापन और जानकारी

इस मैच से संबंधित विस्तृत आंकड़े और आधिकारिक घोषणाएं रग्बी यूनियन की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट या संबंधित खेल प्रसारण माध्यमों पर देखी जा सकती हैं। पाठकों से अनुरोध है कि वेपुष्टि के लिए आधिकारिक स्रोतों की जांच करें।

en_body:
## Bath Ends Winless Run at the Recreation Ground

Joe Cokanasiga scored two tries to help Bath secure a victory over Sale, ending a three-match winless streak across all competitions. The hosts claimed a maximum of five points from the fixture, lifting them to fourth place in the standings as the domestic competition enters an international break.

## Match Summary and Try Scorers

Bath established an early advantage through Henry Arundell, who marked his first Premiership appearance of the season by scoring within the opening three minutes after breaking through from the halfway line. Further tries from Tom de Glanville, Louis Hennessey, and Cokanasiga's double secured the bonus point for the hosts. Fly-half Finn Russell contributed four conversions and a penalty.

Despite trailing for much of the match, Sale managed to secure a losing bonus point thanks to late tries. Nathan Jibulu and Tom O'Flaherty crossed the line during the earlier phases, while Luke Cowan-Dickie and Elia Canakaivata added late scores in the final ten minutes. George Ford kicked four conversions for the visitors, who finished the match in eighth position following their third defeat of the campaign.

## Reaction from the Camps

Bath director of rugby Johann van Graan told BBC Radio Bristol that his side successfully integrated multiple facets of their game, praising their defensive work and attacking phases.

Sale director of rugby Alex Sanderson noted that while his team displayed physical intent and created scoring opportunities, execution errors and defensive lapses in the wide channels proved costly before their late rally.

Interested readers can review the original match report and statistics on the official Premiership Rugby or BBC Sport websites.
